items.title: Laurena Diggs and Carrie Boote Interview, 1959-05-25
items.q: But he was a boyfriend of my cousin's, and actually I knew him for years from being associated with her.

ctx.x: He was from down here. In Mandeville. I thought maybe you knew him.

No. Well, you know, most, if they were connected with any, any of the bands around there, mostly I would know them. But a lot of those, uh, piano players, now, they had a fellow here named Peg Gauman. Gauman. Gauman. He was a colored fellow, but he always passed, and he played down in the district here. Now, he left here, and he went to Chicago. But he, he passed for White, and he played with the orchestra at the Chicago Theater for years. And, of course, he was a very good piano player. But by him going there,…
You said your phone would ring one.
